title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2609.32353v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. translated_title: 更少令牌，更多自我教学：面向极端视觉令牌缩减的在线策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉令牌缩减是加速多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的有效方法，但在极低令牌预算下性能会迅速恶化。现有工作既探索了视觉令牌选择，也探索了通过训练来适应减少视觉输入的方法。我们更进一步，提出了这样一个问题：高度压缩的MLLM应如何从其自身生成所诱导的状态中学习？这一设置自然引出了在线策略自蒸馏的概念：高度压缩的模型在其自身生成所诱导的状态上接受监督，而其全令牌版本则充当信息丰富的教师。基于这一洞察，我们提出了LT-OPD，一个面向极端视觉令牌缩减的训练框架。学生模型仅使用少量视觉令牌生成响应，而同一MLLM的冻结全令牌副本则沿着这些学生生成的轨迹提供分布监督。为了稳定……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LT-OPD在线策略自蒸馏训练框架，让使用极少视觉令牌的压缩学生模型从自身生成的轨迹上接受冻结的全令牌教师模型的分布监督，从而在极端视觉令牌缩减下保持性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes LT-OPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework in which a heavily compressed student model learns from states induced by its own generations, supervised distributionally by a frozen full-token teacher, enabling extreme visual token reduction with stable performance.
